rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It changed the payment method to Visa without first confirming with the user, violating the confirm-before-write rule. It also failed to answer the user’s questions about the gift card balance, whether the recent order used Visa/Mastercard/Amex, and whether the gift card could be applied before proceeding. Authentication is unclear/minimal (only an email lookup is shown). While the tool call to get_order_details could justify stating the original card and refund, the lack of confirmation and incomplete fulfillment of the user’s requests constitute a clear failure under the pass criteria.
